what: CONSTRUCTION_ANCHOR: shape of a POINTS.md anchor fragment
_EVENTS: the five events a clause may target
_NON_ENFORCING: three routed events deliberately not targetable, with reasons
COMMAND_FIELD: the one field name meaning 'reads the command'
event_key: extract cross-event correlation key from predicate.key_from (bare path, or on/pattern/group object; missing field, non-str value, or no regex match all yield '')
writes/returns: correlation key string, truncated to 200 chars

what: _PROBE_CACHE: module-level memo of probe spec -> measured truth, one process per event
reset_probe_cache: clears the probe cache so tests get per-event scope
_run_probe: cache hit returns memoized result, else measures and stores
_measure_probe: subprocess raised OSError/TimeoutExpired/ValueError -> None (not evaluable)
_measure_probe: nonzero returncode -> None (not evaluable)
_measure_probe: expect=='empty' -> output==''
_measure_probe: expect=='nonempty' -> output!=''
_measure_probe: expect is a regex object -> re.search(expect.regex, output) is not None
_base_predicate: predicate.event set and mismatches event.hook_event_name -> False
_base_predicate: predicate.tools set (not ['*']) and event.tool_name not in it -> False
_base_predicate: no own kind, has any_of -> any(sub) composition
_base_predicate: no own kind, has all_of -> all(sub) composition
_base_predicate: kind=='always' -> True
_base_predicate: kind=='effect' -> resolve keel_effect.<effect>, true only if present, not missing, not None, truthy
_base_predicate: resolve predicate.on on event; missing -> False
_base_predicate: kind=='tool' -> value == predicate.equals
_base_predicate: kind=='nonzero' -> int(value)!=0, TypeError/ValueError -> False
_base_predicate: kind=='regex' -> value must be str, else False; else delegate to _regex_predicate
_base_predicate: unknown kind falls through -> False
_regex_predicate: predicate.pattern does not search-match value -> False
_regex_predicate: pattern matched, all predicate.unless entries fail to match -> True else False
_predicate: any leaf is an unmeasured effect (_unmeasured true) -> None (NOT-EVALUABLE)
_predicate: cheap _base_predicate gate fails -> False before any probe runs
_predicate: predicate.probe present -> run it via _run_probe, else True
_unmeasured: event carries a keel_effect record and this predicate's named effect is recorded as None (observer could not see); event/tools mismatch or no record -> False
match: _predicate result None -> print NOT-EVALUABLE to stderr, treat occasion as live -> True (fail closed toward demand)
match: return the measured predicate result unchanged
discharges: clause.discharged_by is None -> False (no guard side to satisfy)
discharges: _predicate result None -> print 'not a pass' warning; return the (falsy) result as-is
_matches_a_tool_enum: True iff predicate itself reads tool_name, or recursively any any_of/all_of branch does
classify_side: predicate is not a dict -> 'absent'
classify_side: composed branches include 'textual' -> whole side is 'textual'
classify_side: composed branches include 'nominal' (and no textual) -> 'nominal'
classify_side: exactly one distinct branch class (plus own) -> that class
classify_side: multiple distinct branch classes, all within AGNOSTIC_CLASSES -> 'composed'
classify_side: multiple distinct branch classes not all agnostic -> 'unclassified'
classify_side: no branches, predicate has own kind -> that own class
classify_side: no branches and no own kind -> 'unclassified'
_own_class: kind=='always' -> 'always'
_own_class: kind=='effect' -> 'effect'
_own_class: kind=='tool' -> 'tool-enum'
_own_class: kind=='regex' and on=='tool_name' -> 'tool-enum'
_own_class: kind=='regex' and on==COMMAND_FIELD -> 'textual', else 'unclassified'
_own_class: kind in ('program','pipeline') -> 'nominal'
_own_class: kind=='nonzero' -> 'positive'
_own_class: any other kind -> 'unclassified'
AGNOSTIC_CLASSES: the side classes licensed on either side (always, tool-enum, effect, positive, composed)
derive_closure: class=='tool-enum' -> 'host'
derive_closure: class=='composed' and some branch reads tool_name -> 'host'
derive_closure: class=='composed' and no branch reads tool_name -> 'world'
derive_closure: class=='effect' -> 'world'
derive_closure: class=='positive' -> 'datum'
derive_closure: any other class (always/nominal/unclassified/absent) -> returned unchanged
KEYABLE_EFFECTS: the effects a subject may key a demand on (files_changed, files_removed, pids_gone)

subject_fields: the event field(s) a subject/discriminator extractor may read -- dict spec's 'on' (default tool_input.command), bare string spec, or a list of field names filtered to non-empty strings

_fixture_event: builds a synthetic event from a predicate's own event/tools declaration; a dict fixture passes through unchanged, a string/scalar fixture is placed at the first declared subject_fields path
PROBE_TIMEOUT_CEILING_MS: ceiling on a clause's probe.timeout_ms, held under the hook's own timeout so a probe cannot outlive its hook
CLAUSE-EFFECT-UNKNOWN: refuses a leaf naming an effect not present in keel.effects.EFFECTS
CLAUSE-NONZERO-NOT-RESPONSE: refuses a nonzero leaf whose 'on' does not start with tool_response. (nonzero must compare a datum the trace produced, never an operator-controlled field)
CLAUSE-REGEX-INVALID: refuses a regex-kind predicate whose pattern or any unless entry fails to compile
CLAUSE-KEY-FROM-INVALID: refuses key_from that is not a nonempty string or a dict with a nonempty string 'on'
CLAUSE-KEY-FROM-INVALID: refuses a key_from.pattern that fails to compile
CLAUSE-KEY-FROM-INVALID: refuses a key_from.group that is not int or str
CLAUSE-PROBE-INVALID: refuses a probe whose cmd/timeout_ms/expect fail the structural shape (nonempty str list, int timeout in (0, ceiling], valid expect shape)
CLAUSE-PROBE-MUTATING: refuses a probe whose argv[0] contains a path separator
CLAUSE-PROBE-MUTATING: refuses a probe whose whole argv is not in the _READ_ONLY_PROBES allowlist
CLAUSE-PROBE-INVALID: refuses a probe expect.regex that fails to compile
_READ_ONLY_PROBES: the only probe argv a clause may run
_leaves: predicate has no any_of/all_of branches -> the predicate itself is the sole leaf
_leaves: predicate has branches -> its own kind (if any) is a leaf too, plus every branch's leaves recursively
AGNOSTIC_OCCASIONS: alias of AGNOSTIC_CLASSES for the occasion-side reading
_discriminator: fingerprint is kind=='always' and clause has a discharged_by -> fixtures are graded against discharged_by (terminal clause: occasion discriminates nothing)
_discriminator: otherwise -> fixtures are graded against the fingerprint itself
_admit: side-class loop over fingerprint/activated_by/discharged_by, skipping any side that is not a dict
CLAUSE-TEXT-COVERING: refuses any side (fingerprint/activated_by/discharged_by) classified 'textual' -- Theorem 1: no pattern edit makes raw-command reading mention-immune
CLAUSE-SIDE-UNCLASSIFIED: refuses any side classified 'unclassified' -- no Coverings.v class covers the shape
CLAUSE-OCCASION-NOMINAL: refuses a fingerprint or activated_by side not in AGNOSTIC_CLASSES -- an occasion must be name-agnostic (Theorem 3, 5)
CLAUSE-GUARD-NOMINAL: refuses a discharged_by side not in AGNOSTIC_CLASSES -- a guard must be name-agnostic too
CLAUSE-GUARD-ALWAYS: refuses a discharged_by of kind=='always' -- a guard paid by any act observes nothing
CLAUSE-NO-ACTIVATION-FIXTURES: refuses a clause with activated_by set but no fixtures_activate
fixtures_activate loop: each activation fixture must satisfy _base_predicate(activated_by, ...), else CLAUSE-ACTIVATION-FIXTURE-MISS
CLAUSE-EVENT-UNKNOWN: refuses a clause.event not among the five in _EVENTS
CLAUSE-NO-FIXTURES: refuses a clause missing fixtures_pos or fixtures_neg
_admit: compiles fingerprint, activated_by, discharged_by via _compile (leaf/regex/key_from/probe checks) before fixture grading
CLAUSE-EFFECT-EVENT: refuses a fingerprint classified 'effect' whose clause.event is not PostToolUse -- an effect occasion is observed after the act
_admit: computes the fixture discriminator via _discriminator(clause)
CLAUSE-SUBJECT-UNKEYABLE-EFFECT: refuses a subject keyed on 'effect' whose value is not exactly one of KEYABLE_EFFECTS
fixtures_pos loop: each positive fixture must satisfy _base_predicate(discriminator, ...), else CLAUSE-FIXTURE-POS-MISS

CLAUSE-FIXTURE-POS-UNKEYABLE: within the fixtures_pos loop, refuses a positive fixture that matches the fingerprint but whose dict subject extractor finds no operand (pattern search + captured group empty)
fixtures_neg loop: each negative fixture must NOT satisfy _base_predicate(discriminator, ...), else CLAUSE-FIXTURE-NEG-HIT
_admit: clause.discharged_by is None -> return clause early, exempt from guard-fixture witnessing (no guard side to witness)
CLAUSE-NO-GUARD-FIXTURES: refuses a clause with a discharged_by but missing fixtures_discharge or fixtures_no_discharge
fixtures_discharge loop: each discharge fixture must satisfy _base_predicate(discharged_by, ...), else CLAUSE-GUARD-FIXTURE-MISS
fixtures_no_discharge loop: each no-discharge fixture must NOT satisfy _base_predicate(discharged_by, ...), else CLAUSE-GUARD-FIXTURE-HIT
EXCUSE_FIELDS: the three prose-excuse field names a row may not carry (why_no_program, guard_vocabulary, waiver)
CLAUSE-CARRIES-AN-EXCUSE: refuses a raw row dict carrying any of EXCUSE_FIELDS
CLAUSE-ID-DUPLICATE: refuses a clause list containing the same id twice
_unique_sorted: returns clauses sorted by id
CLAUSE-BUNDLE-INVALID: refuses a shipped bundle whose top-level JSON value is not a list
load_bundle: parses the JSON bundle file, then loads+admits+uniques every row through _load_object/_unique_sorted
default_bundle: the one clause table path this package loads (clauses.json beside this module)
load_default: loads the one shipped bundle with no loose-file fallback; a missing bundle raises rather than silently returning another table
